page.overview:
Who is Iō?

Iō is a calm individual, often seen with a composed look, even when he is facing strong opponents.

Iō has black eyes and brown hair covered by his forehead protector which he wears in a bandanna-style. He wears the standard attire of the Konoha-nin complete with flak jacket. While working on the Logistical Support and Medical Division compound he wears medical overalls to cover his attire.

As a medical-nin, Iō has excellent chakra control with which he can perform medical ninjutsu. Battle-wise, Iō is a competent shinobi and is capable of using Earth Release, making use of techniques such as the Earth Release: Flying Thrown Stones to bombard targets with, delivering devastating blows with each shard of stone. He also has a great understanding for the use of sealing tags, as he was able to combine them with his Earth Release to help seal away reincarnated shinobi.

Iō is also physically strong, capable of lifting a giant boulder several times his size without difficulty. In case of close-range combat, he is skilled enough to fight a gifted kenjutsu user with just a kunai, although only for a short period. He is also very durable, as he could perform his sealing technique flawlessly even when injured.
